titleEn: Robots don’t replace good dairy management
titleZh: 机器人不能取代良好的奶牛管理
summaryZh: 本文对比了传统挤奶系统与自动挤奶系统（机器人）在奶牛场中的应用，指出尽管机器人能提高一致性并产生有价值的数据，但奶牛健康、环境卫生和持续的管理仍是成功的关键。文章从乳头准备、奶牛清洁、乳房炎检测和挤奶后消毒四个方面展开分析，强调无论采用何种技术，良好的管理实践才是保障乳房健康和高品质牛奶的基础。
featuredReason: 本文为智慧畜牧从业者提供了理性看待自动化技术的视角，强调机器人是工具而非万能解决方案，有助于避免过度依赖技术而忽视基础管理，对牧场决策者和技术人员具有实际指导意义。

Robots don’t replace good dairy management

Dairy Strategies: Automated milking systems improve consistency and generate valuable data, but dairy farmers remain responsible for cow hygiene, udder health and follow-up.

September 24, 2026

schedule3 Min Read

A robotic milking system attaches teat cups to a dairy cow, demonstrating how automated technology can streamline milking while good management remains essential to udder health. Georgijevic/Getty Images

by Carolina Pinzón-Sánchez

Dairy farms today use a wide range of milking systems, from pipelines to conventional parlors to robots. While the equipment may vary, the fundamentals of producing high-quality milk do not. Success still depends on healthy cows, a clean environment and consistent management.

In conventional milking systems, people determine milking schedules, prepare teats, identify abnormal milk or udders, and attach milking units.

In automated milking systems, cows voluntarily enter the robot and are milked based on factors such as time since the previous milking and expected milk yield. Individual teat cups are attached by robotic arms, allowing each quarter to be milked independently while sensors monitor milk flow, quarter performance and milk quality.

Although these systems operate differently, they share the same objective: to milk cows gently, quickly and completely while protecting udder health.

Related:World Dairy Expo: Global stage in the heart of Madison

Teat prep. Whether performed by a person or a robot, teat preparation has the same purpose: to attach a properly functioning milking unit to teats that are clean, dry and well stimulated.

Effective preparation removes bacteria from teat skin, stimulates milk letdown and can improve milking efficiency.

In conventional systems, consistency depends on well-trained employees. In automated systems, teat preparation is automated using rotating brushes, teat prep cups or integrated cleaning systems, depending on the equipment brand.

Regardless of the technology, proper teat preparation and consistency remain crucial for milk quality and udder health.

Clean cows. Even highly effective teat disinfection cannot fully compensate for excessively dirty teats.

Dirty bedding, stalls and alleys increase bacterial exposure and make every milking system less effective. Robots cannot distinguish between a clean teat and a dirty one, and employees work more efficiently when cows arrive clean to be milked.

The cleaner the teat before prepping, the lower the risk of mastitis and bacterial contamination of the bulk tank.

Maintaining clean, dry and comfortable housing improves udder health and supports consistent milking performance. Regular cow hygiene scoring can help identify opportunities for improvement.

Mastitis detection. Mastitis detection also differs between systems.

In conventional systems, where fore-stripping is part of the milking routine, employees visually check for abnormal milk at every milking and intervene according to established protocols.

Automated systems continuously monitor milk quality indicators such as electrical conductivity, milk color and somatic cell count at the quarter level, helping identify changes that may signal mastitis.

Related:Wisconsin dairy farms drop below 5,000 for first time

Both systems have limitations.

Conventional milking systems depend on consistent employee training, adherence to protocols and attention to detail.

Automated systems generate large amounts of data, and highly sensitive sensors can sometimes produce false alerts. To ensure timely and appropriate intervention, farms must be able to interpret the information correctly and follow up by examining cows and collecting milk samples when needed.

Post-milking teat disinfection. After milking, the teat canal remains open and vulnerable to bacterial invasion. Post-milking teat disinfection reduces the number of bacteria on the teat skin and lowers the risk of new intramammary infections.

In conventional milking systems, success depends on consistent application of post-dip by employees. In robotic systems, disinfectants are applied automatically through spray technology.

Regardless of the method used, complete teat coverage is essential. Regularly checking nozzles, spray patterns and equipment performance helps ensure that every teat is properly covered and protected.

Good management is the key

Related:New player in dairy forage production: Short corn

Robots can automate tasks, improve consistency and provide valuable information, while conventional milking systems rely more on skilled employees and direct observation. However, no milking system can replace good management.

Ultimately, the best milking system is the one supported by strong management practices.

When farms focus on clean cows, effective teat preparation, proper post-milking disinfection and timely mastitis detection, they create the foundation for excellent udder health and high-quality milk, regardless of whether cows are milked by people or by robots.

Pinzón-Sánchez is a dairy outreach specialist with the University of Wisconsin-Madison.

translationZh:
当今奶牛场使用多种挤奶系统，从管道式到传统挤奶厅再到机器人。虽然设备可能不同，但生产高品质牛奶的基本原则并未改变。成功仍然取决于健康的奶牛、清洁的环境和持续的管理。

在传统挤奶系统中，人员决定挤奶时间表、准备乳头、识别异常牛奶或乳房，并安装挤奶单元。

在自动挤奶系统中，奶牛自愿进入机器人，根据上次挤奶时间间隔和预期产奶量等因素进行挤奶。独立的乳头杯由机械臂安装，允许每个乳区独立挤奶，同时传感器监测奶流、乳区性能 and 牛奶质量。

尽管这些系统运行方式不同，但它们的目标相同：温和、快速、完全地挤奶，同时保护乳房健康。

**乳头准备。** 无论是人工还是机器人执行，乳头准备的目的相同：将功能正常的挤奶单元安装到清洁、干燥且刺激良好的乳头上。

有效的准备可以去除乳头皮肤上的细菌，刺激排乳反射，并提高挤奶效率。

在传统系统中，一致性取决于训练有素的员工。在自动系统中，乳头准备通过旋转刷、乳头准备杯或集成清洁系统自动完成，具体取决于设备品牌。

无论采用何种技术，正确的乳头准备和一致性对于牛奶质量和乳房健康仍然至关重要。

**清洁的奶牛。** 即使高效的乳头消毒也无法完全弥补过度肮脏的乳头。

肮脏的垫料、牛床和通道会增加细菌暴露，使每种挤奶系统的效果都打折扣。机器人无法区分清洁乳头和肮脏乳头，而当奶牛清洁地进入挤奶时，员工的工作效率也更高。

准备前乳头越干净，患乳房炎和储奶罐细菌污染的风险就越低。

保持清洁、干燥和舒适的牛舍环境可改善乳房健康并支持一致的挤奶性能。定期的奶牛卫生评分有助于发现改进机会。

**乳房炎检测。** 乳房炎检测在不同系统之间也有所不同。

在传统系统中，前挤奶是挤奶常规的一部分，员工在每次挤奶时目视检查异常牛奶，并根据既定方案进行干预。

自动系统持续监测牛奶质量指标，如电导率、牛奶颜色和乳区水平的体细胞计数，帮助识别可能预示乳房炎的变化。

两种系统都有局限性。

传统挤奶系统依赖于持续的员工培训、遵守方案和对细节的关注。

自动系统产生大量数据，高度敏感的传感器有时会产生误报。为确保及时和适当的干预，牧场必须能够正确解读信息，并在需要时通过检查奶牛和采集奶样进行跟进。

**挤奶后乳头消毒。** 挤奶后，乳头管保持开放，容易受到细菌入侵。挤奶后乳头消毒可减少乳头皮肤上的细菌数量，降低新发乳内感染的风险。

在传统挤奶系统中，成功取决于员工持续使用挤奶后药浴。在机器人系统中，消毒剂通过喷雾技术自动施用。

无论使用何种方法，完整的乳头覆盖至关重要。定期检查喷嘴、喷雾模式和设备性能有助于确保每个乳头都得到适当覆盖和保护。

**良好管理是关键**

机器人可以自动化任务、提高一致性并提供有价值的信息，而传统挤奶系统更依赖熟练员工和直接观察。然而，没有任何挤奶系统可以取代良好的管理。

最终，最好的挤奶系统是得到强大管理实践支持的系统。

当牧场专注于清洁的奶牛、有效的乳头准备、适当的挤奶后消毒和及时的乳房炎检测时，它们就为卓越的乳房健康和高品质牛奶奠定了基础，无论奶牛是由人工还是机器人挤奶。
